description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named `CodegenScreen` that provides a user interface for a code generation feature. It includes input fields for describing the code to generate and an optional document reference, as well as controls for selecting programming language and triggering code generation. The widget manages state, interacts with a provider (`CodegenProvider`) for business logic, and displays generated code output within the interface.
